newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos sees no big buys for 12 months.
newsitem.headline: Santos sees no big buys for 12 months.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Thursday it did not expect to make any major acquisitions over the next 12 months but was well-placed to afford any sensible opportunities.
"I don't expect any assets to come on the market of major value and we would certainly feel we could tackle any sensible opportunities," managing director Ross Adler told reporters.
Adler had been asked after the company's annual meeting if it could afford any more acquisitions in the next 12 months given the company's A$800 million capital expenditure programme for 1997.

Santos had a major year of acquisitions in 1996, purchasing WMC Ltd's stake in the East Spar oilfield in Western Australia, MIM Holdings Ltd's oil and gas interests and Parker & Parsley's Australasia assets.
